nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Học hành & dự định · bài tự soạn
title: Group chat · Big dreams
L: Khoa: Guys, I'm thinking of applying for the summer exchange program in Japan.
Linh: Seriously?! That's so cool. You've been talking about Japan since forever!
Khoa: I know, but my Japanese is pretty bad. I'm worried they won't pick me.
Tuan: Just go for it. The worst thing that can happen is they say no.
Linh: And I can help you practice every weekend. We'll make it a habit.
Khoa: You guys are the best. Okay, I'll send in my application tonight, fingers crossed!

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: I'm thinking ___ applying for the summer exchange program in Japan.
exq.why: think of + V-ing = nghĩ đến việc làm gì; at / by / from không đi với thinking trong nghĩa này.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: You've been talking about Japan ___ forever!
exq.why: since forever = từ lâu lắm rồi, đi với hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn (have been talking).

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: Just go ___ it. The worst thing that can happen is they say no.
exq.why: go for it = cứ thử đi, cứ làm đi.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 4: I'll send in my application tonight, fingers ___!
exq.why: fingers crossed = mong may mắn (cụm cố định).
“my Japanese is pretty bad. I’m worried they won’t pick me.”

exq.q: What will Linh do to help Khoa?
exq.a: Practice Japanese with him every weekend
exq.why: “I can help you practice every weekend.”
